product_metadata.title: 2PCS Pool Brush 18 inch Pool Brush Head for Swimming Pool,with Aluminum Back and Nylon Bristle,for Cleaning Pools Wall,Tile and Floor,18inch,with EZ Clip (Excluding Pole)
features: Our pool brush is a very professional cleaning equipment, it is suitable for most of the tile surfaces, such as: pool, bathroom, indoor tile floor and wall, hot spring pool, spa pool, etc.

The upgrade of the product has enhanced the aluminum back and handle, enhanced the oxidation resistance and better corrosion prevention, increased its service life, cleaned more areas at a time, and made the bristles more dense and wear-resistant.
Simple to use, it is suitable for the standard pool brush rod, just insert the brush rod into the handle and align the round hole on the handle to fix it.

The width of this pool brush is nearly 18 inches, which will improve the efficiency of your cleaning work. The curved design of both ends of the brush is convenient to clean the corner of the pool, without leaving out embarrassing stains.
If you have any questions about the introduction and description of the product, you are welcome to contact us by email. We will do our best to provide you with pre-sale and after-sale services.
